newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures eke out gains ahead expiry.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures eke out gains ahead expiry.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures finished a tad firmer on some late short-covering on Thursday ahead of the September contract's settlement.
Dealers said activity was slow and the lead contract looked well entrenched within its recent range of 20,300 to 20,800.
"We're having a terrible sideways market. There's no impact even from bad news," said a senior dealer at a Japanese bank.
He said the market ignored news of a rescue plan for Musashino Shinkin, a small credit association.
Nikkei 225 September futures finished at 20,595 against their previous settlement at 20,585. December were at 20,565 against 20,595.

"We're reaching the end of the first half of the Japanese fiscal year so transactions are rather slow," said the dealer. He said Japanese stocks had not performed well in the last six months after starting the year on firm footing.
